name: mirage
text: Found the cause of live doing nothing right now: the Live master switch on your phone is OFF (it went off around 20:54 UTC, from your Moto G). That one switch turned off the live taker, live bids and the live sockets, so the engine's live lane isn't running at all and tennis can't be judged. Live taker and bids are still paper only. If you meant it off, tell me. If you want live tennis running, turn the Live master back on, or say 'turn it on' and I'll set it from here. Either way, once the lane is up, the engine's live note will show why each matched tennis line is or isn't taken, and I'll fix whatever blocks it.
